dashboard.title: Academy Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Manage your academy overview and settings

create.title: Create Academy
create.subtitle: Set up a new academy for your organization
create.slugHelp: Used in URLs. Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

errors.slugTaken: This slug is already taken. Try a different one.
errors.limitReachedDescription: You've reached your plan's academy limit. Upgrade your plan to create another academy.

profile.title: Academy Profile
profile.subtitle: Manage your academy information
profile.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved profile changes. Are you sure you want to leave?

settings.title: Academy Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure your academy preferences
settings.generalDescription: Your academy's name, web address, and description — this is what students and staff see first.
settings.localizationDescription: The default language, timezone, and currency used across your academy.
settings.contactDescription: How students and staff can reach you — shown on your academy's public pages.
settings.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved settings changes. Are you sure you want to leave?

branding.title: Academy Branding
branding.subtitle: Customize your academy's visual identity
branding.colorsPointer: Looking for brand colors? Set your primary, secondary and accent colors from the Website Builder's Brand tab — they apply to both your public website and your dashboard.
branding.displayNameDescription: The name shown to students across your academy's dashboard and public website.
branding.logoHelp: Upload your academy logo (PNG, JPG, max 5MB). Recommended: 400×96 px or larger, transparent background. SVG scales best.
branding.faviconHelp: Upload your favicon (ICO, PNG, max 1MB). Recommended: 512×512 px square, transparent background.
branding.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved branding changes. Are you sure you want to leave?

errors.logoInvalidType: Logo must be a PNG or JPG image.
errors.faviconInvalidType: Favicon must be an ICO or PNG image.
errors.logoUploadFailed: The logo couldn't be uploaded. Please try again.

members.title: Academy Members
members.subtitle: Manage your academy team members
members.emptyStateDescription: Your academy doesn't have any members yet.

addManager.title: Add an Academy Manager
addManager.description: Grant an Atlas user Manager access to this academy — they'll be able to manage courses, instructors, content and academy settings, but not your organization's billing or subscription.

errors.userNotFound: No Atlas account exists for that email address.
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of this academy.
errors.insufficientRole: Only the academy owner can add a manager.
errors.generic: Could not add this manager. Please try again.

addInstructor.title: Add an Academy Instructor
addInstructor.description: Grant an Atlas user Instructor access to this academy — they'll be able to view their courses, students and submissions, and grade assignments, but not manage academy content or settings.

errors.userNotFound: No Atlas account exists for that email address.
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of this academy.
errors.insufficientRole: Only the academy owner can add an instructor.
errors.limitReached: You've reached your plan's instructor limit. Upgrade your plan to add more.
errors.generic: Could not add this instructor. Please try again.

createStudent.title: Create a Student Account
createStudent.description: This invites a brand-new Atlas account for the student. They'll get an email with a link to set their own password, then they can browse the course catalog and enroll.

errors.insufficientRole: Only the academy owner can create a student account.
errors.generic: Could not create this student account. Please try again.

invited.title: Invitation sent
invited.hint: We've emailed the student a link to set their own password. You never need to share a password with them.

reinvited.title: Student added
reinvited.hint: This person hadn't finished setting up their Atlas account, so we've emailed them a fresh setup link.

added.title: Student added
added.hint: They already have an Atlas account, so they can sign in to this academy with their existing credentials. We've emailed them to let them know.

newAccount.title: New account (optional)
newAccount.description: Leave the name blank if this person already has an Atlas account. Enter their name to invite them — they'll get an email with a link to set their own password.

lookup.new: No Atlas account uses this email yet. Enter their name and we'll email them an invitation to set up their account.
lookup.existingTitle: This person already has an Atlas account
lookup.existingBody: They'll be added to this academy as {{role}} and can sign in with their existing Atlas credentials. We'll email them to let them know. Their name, password and other academies won't change.
lookup.pendingTitle: This person was invited to Atlas but hasn't set up their account yet
lookup.pendingBody: They'll be added to this academy as {{role}}, and we'll email them a fresh link to finish setting up their account.
lookup.alreadyMember: This person is already {{role}} in this academy.
lookup.unavailable: This Atlas account can't be added right now.
lookup.rateLimited: Too many checks in a short time — you can still continue, and we'll check this email when you submit.
lookup.error: We couldn't check this email right now — you can still continue.
lookup.nameReadOnly: This is the name on their Atlas account. Only they can change it.
lookup.nameRequired: Enter a name to invite a new account.

outcome.invited: Invitation sent. They'll get an email to set up their account.
outcome.reinvited: Added. We sent them a fresh link to finish setting up their account.
outcome.added: Added. We've emailed them to let them know.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Learners who registered on your academy website
students.searchPlaceholder: Search students by name or email...
students.emptyDescription: Nobody has registered on this academy's website yet. Students appear here the moment they sign up.

drawer.title: Student
drawer.description: Membership, enrollments and assessment outcomes for this learner.
drawer.readOnlyScope: You are viewing this student through the courses you teach. Managing their membership and enrollments is done by the academy's owner or a manager.

block.title: Block this student
block.description: {{name}} will keep their account but lose access to this academy's courses until you unblock them.
block.reasonPlaceholder: Recorded on the membership and visible to your team.

reject.title: Reject this registration
reject.description: {{name}} will not be admitted to this academy. They can register again later.

enroll.title: Enroll in a course
enroll.description: Give {{name}} access to a course without a purchase.
enroll.noCourses: There is no course left to enroll this student in.
enroll.expiresHelp: Leave empty for access that does not expire.

revoke.title: Revoke access
revoke.description: The student loses access to {{course}} immediately. Their progress is kept.

expiry.title: Access expiry
expiry.description: Choose the day access to {{course}} ends.
expiry.help: Access ends at the end of the chosen day.

errors.generic: That action could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.insufficientRole: Your role on this academy does not allow that action.
errors.studentNotPending: This registration is no longer awaiting approval.
errors.studentBlocked: This student is blocked. Unblock them first.
errors.alreadyEnrolled: This student is already enrolled in that course.
errors.expiryInPast: The expiry date must be in the future.
errors.notFound: That student is no longer on this academy.

policy.title: Registration policy
policy.description: How new learners get onto your academy website.

open.label: Open
open.description: Anyone can create an account on your academy website and start learning.

invite.label: Invite only
invite.description: Only someone with a valid invite link can register.

approval.label: Approval required
approval.description: Anyone can apply; each registration waits as pending until you approve it on the Students tab.

policy.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change the registration policy.
policy.saveFailed: The registration policy could not be saved.

invites.title: Invite links
invites.description: A learner opens an invite link to register on your academy website, whatever the policy says.
invites.emptyDescription: Create one to let a specific person register.

create.title: Create an invite link
create.description: The link is shown once, right after it is created.
create.emailHelp: Leave empty to let anyone with the link register.
create.failed: The invite could not be created.

created.title: Invite created
created.linkDescription: Share this link with the person you are inviting.
created.tokenDescription: This academy has no public address yet, so share the invite code itself.
created.onceWarning: This is the only time it is shown. Copy it now — it cannot be retrieved later.

revoke.title: Revoke this invite link
revoke.description: The link stops working immediately. Anyone who already registered with it keeps their account.
revoke.failed: The invite could not be revoked.

accessLost.title: You no longer have access to that academy
accessLost.goneTitle: That academy is no longer available
accessLost.description: Your access was removed or the academy was deleted. You have been taken to an academy you can open.
accessLost.namedDescription: Your access to {{name}} was removed or the academy was deleted. You have been taken to an academy you can open.

onboarding.resumeBanner: Your academy setup isn't finished yet.

empty.noAcademiesDescription: Create your first academy to get started with Atlas.
empty.noActivityDescription: Activity will appear here as you manage your academy.
empty.noMembersDescription: Add team members to collaborate on your academy.

errors.permissionDenied: You don't have permission to manage this academy

delete.title: Delete this academy
delete.description: Removes the academy from Atlas and takes its public website offline. This cannot be undone.
delete.consequenceWebsite: The academy's public website stops responding immediately.
delete.consequenceAccess: Managers, instructors and students lose access to it.
delete.consequenceAllowance: The academy slot on your plan is freed, so you can create a replacement.
delete.consequenceRecords: Billing and payment records are retained, as they must be, but the academy is no longer active.
delete.confirmDescription: This will take {{name}} offline and cannot be undone.

reasons.replacing_with_another: I am replacing it with another academy
reasons.switching_provider: I am switching to another provider

delete.feedbackLabel: Anything you would like us to know? (optional)
delete.feedbackPlaceholder: Your feedback helps us improve Atlas.
delete.deletedDescription: {{name}} has been deleted and its website is offline.
delete.failedTitle: The academy could not be deleted.

communication.title: Email & sign-in codes
communication.description: When learners are asked for an emailed code at sign-in, and how your academy uses email.

otpPolicy.label: Emailed sign-in code
otpPolicy.description: A 6-digit code sent to the learner's email after a correct password.

inherit.label: Use the platform default
inherit.description: Follow whatever the platform currently recommends.

new_device.label: New devices only
new_device.description: Ask for a code the first time a browser signs in, then remember it.

always.label: Every sign-in
always.description: Ask for a code at every sign-in, even on remembered devices.

off.label: Off
off.description: Never ask learners for an emailed code.

otpPolicy.offWarning: A learner whose password leaks can be signed in from anywhere with no second check. Two-factor authentication on individual accounts still applies.

announcementEmail.label: Announcements by email
announcementEmail.description: Allow announcements to be emailed to learners, in addition to appearing in the app.

digestDefault.label: Default digest for new learners
digestDefault.description: Learners can change this in their own notification settings.

communication.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change communication settings.
communication.saveFailed: The communication settings could not be saved.
communication.readOnlyNotice: These settings follow the platform's configuration and can't be changed per academy yet. Emailed sign-in codes currently apply: {{policy}}.

protection.ownerOnly: Only the academy owner can view or change content protection, video and device settings.

content.title: Video watermark and player
content.description: How your academy's hosted videos are marked and played for learners.

watermark.label: Watermark videos
watermark.description: Draws an identifying overlay on every hosted video a learner watches, so a recording can be traced back to the account it came from.

watermarkText.label: Watermark text
watermarkText.description: Leave blank to show each learner their own short ID (for example “ID 1A2B3C4D”). Custom text replaces that ID for everyone, so the overlay no longer shows which learner was watching. Up to {{count}} characters.
watermarkText.tooLong: Keep the watermark text to 80 characters or fewer.

deterrents.title: Player restrictions

download.label: Download button hidden
download.description: The player does not offer a download option.

pip.label: Picture-in-picture blocked
pip.description: Videos cannot be popped out into a floating window.

contextMenu.label: Right-click menu suppressed
contextMenu.description: “Save video as” is not offered over the player.

deterrents.note: The learner player always applies these, whatever the academy's settings. They discourage casual copying; they do not stop screen recording, and nothing in a browser can.

confirmOn.title: Turn the watermark on?
confirmOn.description: Every learner will see the watermark on every hosted video from their next lesson onwards.

confirmOff.title: Turn the watermark off?
confirmOff.description: Learners will no longer see an identifying overlay on hosted videos, so a recording can no longer be traced back to the account it came from. This applies from their next lesson onwards.

content.saveFailed: The content protection settings could not be saved.

videoTier.title: Video protection tier
videoTier.description: How videos you upload from now on are stored and delivered to learners.

normal.label: Normal
normal.description: Basic video protection: Atlas stores and delivers the video itself, through short-lived links that are only issued to learners with access.

premium.label: Premium
premium.description: Managed video delivery with signed playback, short-lived authorization, restricted playback sites and adaptive streaming quality.

videoTier.notInPlan: Not included in your current plan — upgrade to a Premium plan to choose it.
videoTier.newUploadsOnly: Only new uploads use the tier you choose. Videos already uploaded keep the tier they were uploaded with. Neither tier is DRM.
videoTier.planDefault: Your academy is using your plan's default tier.

confirm.title: Switch new uploads to {{tier}}?
confirm.description: Every video uploaded from now on will be delivered to learners on this tier. Videos already uploaded are not changed.

videoTier.saveFailed: The video tier could not be saved.

devices.title: Learner devices
devices.description: Limits how many devices each learner can use, to make sharing an account inconvenient.

maxDevices.label: Devices per learner
maxDevices.description: How many browsers a learner can keep signed in to this academy. The platform allows up to {{max}}.

maxSessions.label: Concurrent sessions
maxSessions.description: Shown to learners on their Devices page. Lessons play on one device at a time; opening a lesson elsewhere asks the learner to move playback there. The platform allows up to {{max}}.

devices.outOfRange: Enter a whole number between 1 and the maximum shown.

source.academy: These limits are set for this academy.
source.plan: Your academy is using your plan's default limits.
source.platform: Your academy is using the platform's default limits.
source.default: Your academy is using the platform's default limits.

confirm.title: Lower the device limit?
confirm.description: The new limit applies to devices learners have already registered. A learner using more than {{devices}} will be refused on their most recently added devices until they remove one from their Devices page.

devices.saveFailed: The device limits could not be saved.

revenue.title: Revenue & payouts
revenue.description: What this academy has earned from course sales through Atlas Payments, and what Atlas has paid out to it.

forbidden.title: Only the organization owner can view this
forbidden.description: Academy revenue and payouts are visible to the organization owner only. Ask them if you need these figures.

noAcademy.title: No academy selected
noAcademy.description: Choose an academy to see its revenue and payouts.

summary.title: Awaiting payout
summary.description: Net earnings not yet included in a payout: course sales after the Atlas platform fee, minus refunds. Each currency is shown separately.
summary.negative: Refunds currently exceed sales in this currency, so nothing is paid out until new sales cover the difference.
summary.empty: Nothing is awaiting payout right now.

error.title: We couldn't load the balance
error.description: The balance awaiting payout could not be loaded. Please try again.

payouts.title: Payout history
payouts.description: Payouts Atlas has made, or is preparing, for this academy.

empty.title: No payouts yet
empty.description: Payouts appear here once Atlas settles your course sales. Course payments are currently collected by bank transfer through Atlas; online payment gateways aren't available yet.

error.title: We couldn't load payouts
error.description: The payout history could not be loaded. Please try again.
